name: Within
description: Bring your organization's processes and operational knowledge into your AI assistant. The Within MCP connects to your Within workspace so you can query your organization's processes, explore the process index knowledge graph linking processes to systems and teams, and ground answers in how your business actually runs — not generic guesses.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Within to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Within to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.within.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Within MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Within lists 17 MCP tools, including fetch, get_agent_builder_instructions, get_agent_builder_resource, get_artifact_content, get_artifact_details, get_hierarchy_node_details, get_observation_citation, get_process_details, get_process_hierarchy, get_process_observations, get_recent_process_changes, and list_accessible_workspaces.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Within?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Within in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Within requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Within is developed by Within. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
